review_evidence: README describes LeanAideTools as the zero-dependency Lean client/tool integration for LeanAide, including theorem/definition translation syntax and automatic proof-tactic mode.

All 12 current-primary files are confined to the LeanAideTools library, its test/demo modules and Main entry point; these files expose the source-owned elaboration/tactic interface rather than a duplicate generated corpus.
ClashExample, InstanceClash and TestAsync naming was not treated as sufficient evidence for exclusion because they exercise the project’s metaprogramming/typeclass interface.
summary: Retain LeanAideTools in full: its small source tree defines the client syntax, asynchronous tactic mode and supporting examples/tests for the formalization tool interface.
